title: December 19, 2019 Health & Human Services Committee Special Called Meeting
meeting_type: Health & Human Services Committee Special Called Meeting
transcript:
THE HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES COMMITTEE WILL 
MEET ON THURSDAY, DECEMBER 19, 2019 AT 9:00 AM, 
AUSTIN CITY HALL
301 W. SECOND STREET
AUSTIN, TX
Natasha Harper-Madison, Chair
Delia Garza, Vice Chair
Kathie Tovo, Member
Ann Kitchen, Member
Special Called Meeting
A quorum of the City Council may be present at this meeting. Action will only be taken by the members of the 
committee.
The committee may go into a closed session under the Open Meetings Act, Section 551.071, of the Texas 
Government Code, to receive advice from legal counsel on any item on this agenda.
CALL TO ORDER
Citizen Communication: General
Discussion and Possible Action
1.
Discussion the appointment of members to the Sobriety Center Local Government Corporation
Board of Directors.
Sponsors:
Council Member Natasha Harper-Madison, and Council Member Kathie Tovo
Executive Session
2.
Discuss the appointment of members to the Sobriety Center Local Government Corporation Board
of Directors. (Personnel matters - Section 551.074 of the Government Code).
Sponsors:
Council Member Natasha Harper-Madison, and Council Member Kathie Tovo
Future Items
ADJOURN
